capabilities: Keep or write results to notes.
extras: Optional visual skins (Parchment and Arcane) are a one-time purchase through Polar. The plugin requires no account and has no telemetry.
intentEvidence: Roll dice right in your notes with a full formula notation.
motivation: Made by Thijs at Dortus for game masters and solo players who keep their sessions in Obsidian.
problem: Game masters and solo players need an integrated way to handle dice rolls and complex calculations within their note-taking workflow without switching applications.

relations.evidence: a button copies named formulas from the data file of the Dice Roller plugin, if you have it.

summary: Roll dice directly within Obsidian notes using full formula notation, allowing rolls to be repeated, logged, and used to pull data from other notes.
